concerns.text: Multiple critical execution tasks (marked [ ]) are missing implementation logic or are blocked by incomplete prerequisites (e.g., T012a-ser depends on T012a which is [X] but T012a-ser is [ ]). Specifically, T012a-ser, T012a-val, T013c, T013c-verify, T015a-exec, T015b-exec, T016-impl-log, T016-impl-align, T016-impl-missing, T016-impl-combat, T015-exec, T020a-exec, T021b-exec, T021d-exec, T022-exec, T026a-exec, T026b-exec, T026c-exec are all marked [ ] (incomplete) despite being required for the pipeline to function. This indicates a failure to cover the spec's FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, FR-011, FR-012, FR-013, FR-014.

Task T015a (Detect label heterogeneity) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and is a pre-requisite for T015b-exec. The spec requires handling label heterogeneity (FR-013, US-1), but the task is not implemented, blocking downstream label harmonization.

Tasks T016-impl-log, T016-impl-align, T016-impl-missing, T016-impl-combat are marked [ ] (incomplete) but are required for T015-exec (Preprocessing). The spec requires log-transformation, InChIKey alignment, missing value filtering, and ComBat batch correction (FR-002, FR-004, US-1), but these tasks are not implemented.

Tasks T020a-exec, T021b-exec, T021d-exec, T022-exec are marked [ ] (incomplete) but are required for model training and validation. The spec requires data splitting, model validation, sensitivity analysis, and collinearity diagnostics (FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-009, FR-012, US-2), but these tasks are not implemented.

Tasks T026a-exec, T026b-exec, T026c-exec are marked [ ] (incomplete) but are required for biological interpretation. The spec requires extracting top metabolites, mapping pathways, and generating reports (FR-010, FR-011, US-3), but these tasks are not implemented.

Task T047 is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is listed as a pre-requisite for T016-impl-align. The task description mentions 'Pre-requisite: T016-impl-align must complete', creating a circular dependency. This is a writing error in the task definition.
